title: Lawdeedaw
html_source:
Of the “upper class”, also often spelled “La-dee-dah”.

This could both be a reference to Stephen’s reluctance to accept food as a guest, and the fact that the offered food is too humble for him.

 — He has nothing to sit down on, sir. 

 — He has nowhere to put it, you mug. Bring in our chippendale chair. Would you like a bite of something? None of your damned

airs here. The rich of a rasher fried with a herring? Sure? So much the better. We have nothing in the house but backache pills. 

 All'erta!
